About 12,000 stitches

BACK PATCH · D
!
Back RIGHT (as worn). Top of the patch flush with the top of the waistband, centred between centre back loop and right back loop. Two layers: tree in front, back panel behind, joined only in the middle 3 cm at top and bottom. 4 snaps HIDDEN behind, plain caps without letters. A belt up to 4 cm runs through.
Embroidery artwork. The snaps in this picture are NOT visible on the real patch: they sit hidden behind.REFERENCE

FINISHED SIZE

Embroidery on pre-shrunk natural linen, max. 4 colours: dark brown 19-1432 TCX, copper-gold 17-1340 TCX, gold 14-0952 TCX, bright red 18-1662 TCX
Snaps: ring-spring 10 mm, antique copper, cap and socket on the back panel, stud on the jeans with 2 × 2 cm reinforcement inside
Stiff interlining in the patch
